meta.pageTitleEn: How to Apply for a Chinese Visa | Requirements & Process 2026
meta.pageTitleZh: 中国签证申请完整指南｜材料、流程、常见问题 2026
meta.pageDescEn: Check whether you need a China visa first, then review visa-free routes, 24-hour or 240-hour transit, Hainan entry, visa types, documents and application steps. Official rules can vary by nationality and location.
meta.pageDescZh: 先判断是否需要中国签证，再核对单方面免签、互免签证、24小时或240小时过境、海南免签，以及签证类型、材料和申请流程。具体要求以适用官方机构为准。
meta.lastUpdateHintEn: For reference only, subject to consulate official announcements
meta.lastUpdateHintZh: 仅供参考，以使领馆官方公告为准

intro.para1En: Do not start with a visa application. First check whether your nationality and itinerary qualify for a visa-free route: unilateral visa-free entry, a mutual exemption agreement, general 24-hour transit, 240-hour transit, or Hainan regional visa-free entry. If none applies, choose the appropriate Chinese visa type and apply before travel.
intro.para1Zh: 不要先急着办签证。第一步应先判断您的国籍和行程是否符合单方面免签、互免签证、24小时过境免签、240小时过境免签或海南区域免签；如果这些路径都不适用，再选择对应的中国签证类型并按要求提前申请。
intro.para2En: Important note: This website serves as informational reference only. Final rules, forms and decisions belong to Chinese embassies, consulates-general and visa service centres.
intro.para2Zh: 重要提示：本站仅作资讯参考；最终申请要求、表格、审批结果以中国驻外大使馆、总领事馆及签证申请中心为准。

visaTypesTitleEn: Common Visa Types for Foreign Visitors
visaTypesTitleZh: 外籍访客常用签证类型

visaTypes.descEn: For tourism and sightseeing. Check the current consular requirements for itinerary, accommodation and other supporting documents.
visaTypes.descZh: 用于旅游观光。行程、住宿及其他支持材料以受理地最新要求为准。

visaTypes.descEn: For commercial and trade activities. Supporting documents may include an invitation or business-related documents.
visaTypes.descZh: 用于商贸活动。通常需要根据受理地要求提供邀请函或商务相关材料。

visaTypes.descEn: For non-commercial exchanges, visits, study tours and other qualifying activities.
visaTypes.descZh: 用于交流、访问、考察等符合规定的非商业活动。

visaTypes.descEn: Q1 is generally for family reunion or long-term family residence; Q2 is generally for short-term family visits.
visaTypes.descZh: Q1通常用于长期探亲、团聚等情形；Q2通常用于短期探亲访问。

visaTypes.descEn: X1 is generally for long-term study and X2 for short-term study. Supporting admission or study documents are typically required.
visaTypes.descZh: X1通常用于长期学习，X2通常用于短期学习；一般需按要求提供录取或学习相关材料。

visaTypes.descEn: For employment in China. Required work authorization and supporting documents must be handled according to the applicable rules.
visaTypes.descZh: 用于在中国工作。需按适用规定办理工作许可等前置手续并提供相关材料。

visaTypes.descEn: For qualifying private affairs, including visits to family members working or studying in China, subject to the relevant conditions.
visaTypes.descZh: 用于符合规定的私人事务，例如探望在中国工作或学习的亲属等，具体以适用条件为准。

visaTypes.descEn: For qualifying foreign journalists. Additional approval and supporting documents may be required.
visaTypes.descZh: 用于符合规定的外国记者来华采访等活动，可能涉及额外审批和材料要求。

visaTypes.titleEn: G / C / D / R and Other Categories
visaTypes.titleZh: G / C / D / R等其他类别
visaTypes.descEn: Transit, crew, permanent-residence and other special-purpose categories have their own conditions. Use the official consular guidance for the exact category.
visaTypes.descZh: 过境、乘务、永久居留及其他特殊类别各有适用条件，应按官方受理机构要求确认具体类别。

docList.descEn: A passport meeting the validity and blank-page requirements of the place and visa category. Many visa centers ask for at least six months validity and two blank visa pages, but requirements can vary.
docList.descZh: 符合受理地和签证类别要求的护照。许多签证中心要求护照有效期通常不少于6个月并有至少2页空白签证页，但具体要求可能因地点和类别而异。

docList.descEn: Complete the current application form and provide a compliant recent photo according to the official instructions.
docList.descZh: 按最新官方要求完整填写申请表，并提供符合规定的近期证件照片。

docList.titleZh: 与出行事由对应的支持材料
docList.descEn: Depending on the visa, this can include an invitation letter, admission notice, employment/work authorization, family relationship proof or other documents.
docList.descZh: 根据签证类别，可能包括邀请函、录取通知书、工作许可、亲属关系证明等材料。

docList.titleEn: Travel and status documents when required
docList.titleZh: 必要时提供行程及身份相关材料
docList.descEn: Some locations or categories may request itinerary, accommodation, residence-status or other additional documents. Check the local official checklist.
docList.descZh: 部分受理地或签证类别可能要求行程、住宿、合法居留身份等额外材料，应核对当地官方材料清单。

processSteps.titleEn: Check whether you need a visa
processSteps.descEn: Check your nationality, passport type, purpose, destination and itinerary against the applicable visa-free or transit routes.
processSteps.descZh: 结合国籍、护照类型、出行目的、目的地和行程，先核对是否存在适用的免签或过境路径。

processSteps.descEn: If a visa is required, select the category that matches the actual purpose of travel and check the local official checklist.
processSteps.descZh: 如果确实需要签证，应根据实际出行目的选择类别，并核对受理地官方材料清单。

processSteps.descEn: Complete the current application form and prepare the required supporting documents.
processSteps.descZh: 填写当前有效的官方申请表，并准备对应的支持材料。

processSteps.descEn: Submit to the Chinese embassy/consulate or an authorized visa application service center, as applicable to your place of application.
processSteps.descZh: 根据您所在地区和适用规则，向中国使领馆或授权签证申请中心递交申请。

processSteps.descEn: Pay the applicable fee, complete any requested follow-up procedure, and collect your passport when instructed. Processing times and fees vary by location and service.
processSteps.descZh: 按要求缴费并完成后续程序，在通知时间取回护照。办理时效和费用会因受理地及服务类型而不同。

processSteps.titleEn: Check the issued visa before travel
processSteps.descEn: Check entries, validity dates, duration of stay and other information on the issued visa before departure.
processSteps.descZh: 出行前核对签证上的入境次数、有效期、停留期限等信息。

processingNoteEn: Processing times and fees are not a single nationwide standard. Check the current notice of the Chinese embassy, consulate-general or authorized visa application center handling your application.
processingNoteZh: 办理时效和费用并非全国统一固定标准，应以负责受理您申请的中国使领馆或授权签证申请中心当前公告为准。

visaFaqs.qEn: Can I enter China and get an ordinary tourist or business visa at the border?
visaFaqs.qZh: 可以到了中国口岸再办理普通旅游或商务签证吗？
visaFaqs.aEn: Do not assume that a regular tourist or business visa can be issued on arrival. Ordinary visa applicants should normally complete the required application process before travel. Limited special arrangements may exist in specific circumstances, so check the competent Chinese authority for your case.
visaFaqs.aZh: 不要默认普通旅游或商务签证可以到口岸落地办理。普通签证申请人通常应在出行前完成规定的申请程序；个别特殊情形可能另有安排，应向适用的中国主管机构核实。

visaFaqs.qZh: 拿到签证就一定可以入境吗？
visaFaqs.aEn: No. A visa permits you to seek entry under its conditions; border inspection authorities make the final entry decision at the port.
visaFaqs.aZh: 不一定。签证是在符合其条件下申请入境的许可文件之一，最终是否准予入境由口岸边检机关依法作出决定。

visaFaqs.qEn: Can I extend my stay after entering China?
visaFaqs.qZh: 入境中国后可以延长停留时间吗？
visaFaqs.aEn: Depending on the circumstances and visa/status, an application may be possible through the local Exit-Entry Administration before the permitted stay expires. Approval is not automatic.
visaFaqs.aZh: 根据具体情况和签证/居留身份，部分人员可在停留期限届满前向当地出入境管理部门申请相关手续，但并非自动获批。

visaFaqs.qEn: Do visa requirements differ by country of application?
visaFaqs.qZh: 不同国家递交签证，要求会不一样吗？
visaFaqs.aEn: Yes. Forms, appointment rules, document checklists, fees, processing times and whether a visa center is used can vary by location and applicant status.
visaFaqs.aZh: 会。申请表、预约方式、材料清单、费用、办理时效以及是否通过签证中心受理，都可能因申请地点和申请人身份而不同。

visaFaqs.qEn: Where should I verify the final requirements?
visaFaqs.qZh: 最终应该在哪里核对要求？
visaFaqs.aEn: Use the official Chinese embassy or consulate, authorized visa application service center, and National Immigration Administration information applicable to your route.
visaFaqs.aZh: 应以中国驻当地使领馆、授权签证申请中心以及国家移民管理局针对相应入境路径发布的官方信息为准。
